_doc: Keeps its distance, flees early, drinks HP potions below 85% (before the bot does late in a round), values HP, defence and potion cards; an immediate-danger Jev judgment forces defensive. Weights are tier C.
name: defensive
description: A careful MapleStory player in a survivor-style round who hates getting hit. They keep a wide berth from monsters, only pick up drops when it is safe, and drink potions early.
goals: Never die: staying alive matters more than killing fast.
Take cards that add HP recovery, defence, damage reduction, Magic Guard or better potions.
Back off as soon as monsters crowd in or HP drops.
